fields.note: Photoshop DOM layer id is used when exposed. If unavailable, the exporter falls back to a path hash and emits a warning.
Text content may be readable, but TMP-ready font, size, color, tracking, leading, alignment and rich style mapping remain warnings.
Layer masks and vector masks are not serialized in the first pass.
Photoshop layer effects are not serialized as Unity-ready effects in the first pass.
Smart object source, transforms and placed documents need later batchPlay coverage.
The plugin attempts to duplicate each visible leaf layer into a temporary Photoshop document, trim transparent bounds and save a PNG. Failures are recorded per node as warnings.
